raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds strings (e.g. 1768543211000 = 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, matching the other batches' ~06:00 start pattern), and the plain CAST to TIMESTAMP fails on them. The fix parses all-digit values as epoch ms in UTC and leaves the other rows unchanged.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{12,14}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM p"}}
